_comment: Cursor: copy to .cursor/mcp.json (gitignored) to give Cursor's agent the Harold MCP tools. ${workspaceFolder} is the folder that holds .cursor/, so no path to edit. Credentials live in ~/.harold/env, read by bin/harold-mcp. Never put keys in this file. First: bin/harold-setup-crm and (cd tools/harold-mcp && npm install).
